admission_override: One fixed candidate level per scope and at most one GPU attempt; inherited legacy descent text is not used by the selected R4 clients.

input_adaptation.text_processing: Inherited renderer collapses context whitespace while applying the word cap; these are benchmark-derived controlled inputs, not an exact author benchmark reproduction.

metric_boundary: Preserve the frozen LongBench-style QA F1, RULER substring matching and legacy SequenceMatcher-based RepoBench edit-similarity implementation. No scorer is changed; no exact author RepoBench reproduction or semantic-correctness guarantee is claimed.
clock: Original closed-loop shared-wave readiness; all planning and synchronous qualification included in wall; paired throughput capacity measurement.
full_cost_boundary: Server startup/pre-measurement infrastructure checks excluded identically; every actual business/controller/GPU qualification/failed attempt included. Audit/flush after drain reported separately.
source_cluster_units: Cold two-source shared-wave cohort; fanout source template with all tenants. Three paired fresh process repeats, not IID queries.
cost_forecast_limits: Development bootstrap predictors estimate early eligibility and qualification issuance, not post-certificate application-error probability. They are empirical, not formal risk bounds. The gate credits only currently observed issued-prefix warmth, not speculative future qualifications warming other query scopes. False negatives and capacity/tail tradeoffs are retained.

dynamic_scope_boundary.key: authorized template namespace and exact query digest; stable compiled prefix hash must match
dynamic_scope_boundary.digest_binds: query text, full system message, stable segments, model, output budget, seed14014, temperature0, policy hash and renderer version
dynamic_scope_boundary.observation_schema: [PRIVATE_TOOL_OBS] revision_session=<alnum_or_underscore_or_hyphen>; turn=<digits>; status=ready|completed|idle; no additional answer evidence. All fields must match the complete regex; CHAT_HISTORY/SCRATCHPAD are unqualified.
dynamic_scope_boundary.first_occurrence: actual raw business output with complete answer/EOS witness before one single-shot qualification
dynamic_scope_boundary.query_shared_eligibility: short nonabstaining answer; literal stable-context span or nonliteral raw minimum strictly above .125; backend raw .0625 and candidate/EOS .125 floors retained
dynamic_scope_boundary.nonshareable: References failing the normalized <=16-word, nonabstaining, literal-or-margin eligibility receive exact-observation-only classification with no declared exact reuse and therefore L0. This is a structural heuristic, not a semantic detector of every free-form answer; it imposes no separate hard token-length limit.
dynamic_scope_boundary.scope_invalidation: new query digest/namespace or changed stable content cannot reuse the old qualification; inherited dependency/layout eligibility remains required
dynamic_scope_boundary.changing_observation: only the declared benchmark sessions are empirically audited. Reference eligibility is a heuristic; first-path qualification does not prove all future observation variants preserve free-generation behavior.
